faqs.question: What does rodent proofing include in Dyker Heights homes?
faqs.answer: Our rodent proofing service includes a complete exterior inspection, sealing all entry points with steel wool and caulk, installing door sweeps, covering vents with hardware cloth, sealing gaps around pipes and utilities, and addressing foundation cracks. We focus on the basement, garage, and exterior vulnerabilities common in Dyker Heights homes.

faqs.question: How much does rodent proofing cost in Dyker Heights?
faqs.answer: Call for a free phone consultation and detailed pricing with no hidden fees, ensuring you understand exactly what's included before we begin work.

faqs.question: How long does rodent proofing last?
faqs.answer: Professional rodent proofing using quality materials typically lasts 5-10 years or longer when properly maintained. We use durable, weather-resistant materials designed to withstand Brooklyn's climate.

faqs.question: Will rodent proofing work if I already have mice or rats?
faqs.answer: Rodent proofing is most effective after active infestations are eliminated through trapping or baiting. We recommend combining rodent removal services with proofing for complete protection. Our team will assess your situation during the phone consultation and create a comprehensive plan to remove existing rodents and prevent future entry into your Dyker Heights home.
